description: A copper heating pipe in the basement boiler room had failed at a joint and was dripping. The plumber cut out about a meter of the old pipe, reconnected it with new fittings and re-insulated the repaired section with rock wool. He was on site around a day and a half with a helper for part of it. Afterwards he cleaned and disinfected the tiled area around where the water had been standing.

lines.1: Copper pipe repair – fittings, pipe section and consumables | 1 flat rate
lines.2: Labour – service technician and helper 1 flat rate
lines.7: Tile cleaning, disinfection and coating 5 hrs
